parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "QueryString": "WITH
-- Period definitions: generate all required time buckets
periods AS (
    -- Year
    SELECT
        'year' AS level,
        CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS period,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AS start_date,
        CURRENT_DATE AS end_date,
        1 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL
    -- Previous month
    SELECT
        'month' AS level,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' MONTH, '%M %Y') AS period,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1' MONTH AS start_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AS end_date,
        2 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL
    -- Current month
    SELECT
        'month' AS level,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE), '%M %Y') AS period,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) AS start_date,
        CURRENT_DATE AS end_date,
        3 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL
    -- Weeks of current month (generated dynamically)
    SELECT
        'week' AS level,
        CONCAT(
            'Week ', CAST(WEEK_OF_YEAR(week_start) AS VARCHAR),
            ' · ',
            DATE_FORMAT(week_start, '%d'),
            '–',
            DATE_FORMAT(week_start + INTERVAL '6' DAY, '%d %b')
        ) AS period,
        week_start AS start_date,
        LEAST(
            week_start + INTERVAL '7' DAY,
            CURRENT_DATE
        ) AS end_date,
        100 + WEEK_OF_YEAR(week_start) AS sort_order
    FROM (
        SELECT
            DATE_TRUNC(
                'week',
                DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1' DAY * w.n
            ) AS week_start
        FROM UNNEST(
            SEQUENCE(
                0,
                DATE_DIFF(
                    'day',
                    DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE),
                    CURRENT_DATE
                )
            )
        ) AS w(n)
    ) weeks
    WHERE week_start >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
      AND week_start < CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY week_start
    UNION ALL
    -- Days of current/latest week
    SELECT
        'day' AS level,
        CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(day_date, '%d %b'), ' · ', DATE_FORMAT(day_date, '%W')) AS period,
        day_date AS start_date,
        day_date + INTERVAL '1' DAY AS end_date,
        200 + DAY_OF_YEAR(day_date) AS sort_order
    FROM (
        SELECT DATE_TRUNC('week', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1' DAY) + INTERVAL '1' DAY * d.n AS day_date
        FROM UNNEST(SEQUENCE(0, 6)) AS d(n)
    ) days
    WHERE day_date < CURRENT_DATE
),
-- Daily metrics aggregated per period and brand
daily_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.level, p.period, p.sort_order,
        pd.brand,
        SUM(pd.cnt_fd) AS ftd,
        SUM(pd.cnt_sd) AS std,
        SUM(pd.cnt_reg) AS registrations,
        SUM(pd.deposit_amount_eur) AS total_dep,
        SUM(pd.deposit_amount_eur) - SUM(pd.withdrawal_amount_eur) AS in_out,
        SUM(pd.deposit_count) AS deposit_count,
        SUM(pd.deposit_amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE pd.is_streamer = false) AS hold_deposits,
        SUM(pd.withdrawal_amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE pd.is_streamer = false) AS hold_withdrawals,
        SUM(COALESCE(pd.casino_ggr_eur, 0) + COALESCE(pd.sport_ggr_eur, 0)) AS ggr,
        SUM(pd.ngr_eur) AS ngr,
        SUM(COALESCE(pd.casino_turnover_eur, 0) + COALESCE(pd.sport_turnover_eur, 0)) AS turnover
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_product_dashboard_hyper pd
    JOIN periods p ON pd.as_of_date >= p.start_date AND pd.as_of_date < p.end_date
    WHERE pd.is_test = false
      AND p.level != 'year'
    GROUP BY p.level, p.period, p.sort_order, pd.brand
),
-- Year level: from agg_all_report_statistics_hyper (includes current month, updated daily)
year_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        'year' AS level, CAST(YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AS VARCHAR) AS period, 1 AS sort_order,
        brand,
        SUM(cnt_fd) AS ftd,
        SUM(cnt_sd) AS std,
        SUM(cnt_reg) AS registrations,
        SUM(deposit_amount_eur) AS total_dep,
        SUM(deposit_amount_eur) - SUM(withdrawal_amount_eur) AS in_out,
        SUM(deposit_count) AS deposit_count,
        SUM(deposit_amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE is_streamer = false) AS hold_deposits,
        SUM(withdrawal_amount_eur) FILTER (WHERE is_streamer = false) AS hold_withdrawals,
        SUM(COALESCE(casino_ggr_eur, 0) + COALESCE(sport_ggr_eur, 0)) AS ggr,
        SUM(ngr_eur) AS ngr,
        SUM(COALESCE(casino_turnover_eur, 0) + COALESCE(sport_turnover_eur, 0)) AS turnover
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_all_report_statistics_hyper
    WHERE as_of_date >= DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
      AND is_test = false
    GROUP BY brand
),
-- Payment data (AR PSP, Dep2Try) aggregated per period and brand
ph2_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.level, p.period, p.sort_order,
        br.brand,
        SUM(CASE WHEN br.transaction_status = 'Success' and br.transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN br.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS successful_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN br.transaction_type = 'deposit' THEN br.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_attempts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN br.transaction_status = 'Success' THEN br.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS successful_trans,
        SUM(br.cnt_transaction) AS total_trans_attempts
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_billing_report_hyper br
    JOIN periods p ON br.create_date >= p.start_date AND br.create_date < p.end_date
    WHERE br.is_test = false
    GROUP BY p.level, p.period, p.sort_order, br.brand
),
-- 3-hour intervals for current day (from hourly source)
hour_3_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        '3h' AS level,
        CONCAT(
            LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(HOUR(h.as_of_date) / 3) * 3 AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'), ':00–',
            LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(HOUR(h.as_of_date) / 3) * 3 + 3 AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'), ':00'
        ) AS period,
        30000 + FLOOR(HOUR(h.as_of_date) / 3) * 3 AS sort_order,
        h.brand,
        SUM(h.cnt_fd) AS ftd,
        SUM(h.cnt_sd) AS std,
        SUM(h.cnt_reg) AS registrations,
        SUM(h.deposit_amount) AS total_dep,
        SUM(h.deposit_amount) - SUM(h.withdrawal_amount) AS in_out,
        SUM(h.deposit_count) AS deposit_count,
        NULL AS hold_deposits,
        NULL AS hold_withdrawals,
        SUM(COALESCE(h.casino_ggr, 0) + COALESCE(h.sport_ggr, 0)) AS ggr,
        SUM(
            COALESCE(h.casino_ggr, 0) + COALESCE(h.sport_ggr, 0)
            - (
                COALESCE(h.manual_bonus_amount, 0)
                + COALESCE(h.crm_casino_bonuses_amount, 0)
                - COALESCE(h.crm_casino_bonuses_withdrawal, 0)
                + COALESCE(h.casino_bonus, 0)
                + COALESCE(h.bonuses_amount, 0)
                - COALESCE(h.bonuses_withdrawal, 0)
                + COALESCE(h.free_bet_bonus, 0)
                - COALESCE(h.free_bet_write_off, 0)
                + COALESCE(h.cashback_bonus_amount, 0)
            )
        ) AS ngr,
        SUM(COALESCE(h.casino_base_turnover, 0) + COALESCE(h.sport_turnover, 0)) AS turnover
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_product_dashboard_hourly_hyper h
    WHERE DATE(h.as_of_date) = CURRENT_DATE
      AND h.is_test = false
    GROUP BY FLOOR(HOUR(h.as_of_date) / 3) * 3, h.brand
),
hour_3_ph2 AS (
    SELECT
        CONCAT(
            LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(HOUR(ph.create_date) / 3) * 3 AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'), ':00–',
            LPAD(CAST(FLOOR(HOUR(ph.create_date) / 3) * 3 + 3 AS VARCHAR), 2, '0'), ':00'
        ) AS period,
        ph.brand,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ph.trx_type = 'deposit' AND ph.transaction_status = 'Success' THEN ph.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS successful_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ph.trx_type = 'deposit' THEN ph.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposit_attempts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ph.transaction_status = 'Success' THEN ph.cnt_transaction ELSE 0 END) AS successful_trans,
        SUM(ph.cnt_transaction) AS total_trans_attempts ,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ph.trx_type = 'deposit' AND ph.transaction_status in ('Success', 'New') THEN ph.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS hold_deposits,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ph.trx_type = 'withdrawal' AND ph.transaction_status in ('Success', 'New') THEN ph.amount_eur ELSE 0 END) AS hold_withdrawals
    FROM operator_ro_normcasino.agg_ph2_hourly_hyper ph
    WHERE DATE(ph.create_date) = CURRENT_DATE
      AND ph.is_test = false
    GROUP BY FLOOR(HOUR(ph.create_date) / 3) * 3, ph.brand
),
-- Combine all levels
all_metrics AS (
    SELECT level, period, sort_order, brand, ftd, std, registrations, total_dep, in_out,
           deposit_count, hold_deposits, hold_withdrawals, ggr, ngr, turnover
    FROM daily_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT level, period, sort_order, brand, ftd, std, registrations, total_dep, in_out,
           deposit_count, hold_deposits, hold_withdrawals, ggr, ngr, turnover
    FROM year_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT level, period, sort_order, brand, ftd, std, registrations, total_dep, in_out,
           deposit_count, hold_deposits, hold_withdrawals, ggr, ngr, turnover
    FROM hour_3_metrics
)
-- Final calculations. One row per brand per period; one Slack message per brand.
-- SBNORM is excluded here: it reports zeros across every metric and is not part of the report.
    SELECT
        m.brand,
        m.level,
        m.period,
        CAST(m.ftd AS BIGINT) AS ftd,
        CAST(m.std AS BIGINT) AS std,
        CAST(ROUND(m.total_dep) AS BIGINT) AS total_dep,
        CAST(ROUND(m.in_out) AS BIGINT) AS in_out,
        CAST(ROUND(m.ggr) AS BIGINT) AS ggr,
        CAST(ROUND(m.ngr) AS BIGINT) AS ngr,
        ROUND(CASE WHEN m.turnover > 0 THEN m.ggr * 100.0 / m.turnover ELSE 0 END, 1) AS margin_pct,
        ROUND(CASE
            WHEN m.level = '3h' AND COALESCE(hp.hold_deposits, 0) > 0
                THEN (hp.hold_deposits - hp.hold_withdrawals) * 100.0 / hp.hold_deposits
                WHEN m.level != '3h' AND m.hold_deposits > 0
                THEN (m.hold_deposits - m.hold_withdrawals) * 100.0 / m.hold_deposits
                ELSE 0 END, 1) AS hold,
        ROUND(CASE WHEN m.registrations > 0 THEN m.ftd * 100.0 / m.registrations ELSE 0 END, 1) AS reg2dep,
        ROUND(CASE WHEN m.ftd > 0 THEN m.std * 100.0 / m.ftd ELSE 0 END, 1) AS ftd2std,
        ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ph.total_trans_attempts, hp.total_trans_attempts) > 0
              THEN COALESCE(ph.successful_trans, hp.successful_trans) * 100.0
                   / COALESCE(ph.total_trans_attempts, hp.total_trans_attempts)
              ELSE 0 END, 1) AS ar_psp,
        ROUND(CASE WHEN COALESCE(ph.total_deposit_attempts, hp.total_deposit_attempts) > 0
              THEN COALESCE(ph.successful_deposits, hp.successful_deposits) * 100.0
                   / COALESCE(ph.total_deposit_attempts, hp.total_deposit_attempts)
              ELSE 0 END, 1) AS ar_psp_deposits
    FROM all_metrics m
    LEFT JOIN ph2_metrics ph ON m.level = ph.level AND m.period = ph.period AND m.brand = ph.brand AND m.level != '3h'
    LEFT JOIN hour_3_ph2 hp ON m.period = hp.period AND m.brand = hp.brand AND m.level = '3h'
    WHERE m.brand NOT IN ('SBNORM')
    ORDER BY m.brand, m.sort_order",
  "QueryExecutionContext": { "Database": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaDatabase }}", "Catalog": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaCatalog || 'AwsDataCatalog' }}" },
  "WorkGroup": "{{ $('Config').first().json.athenaWorkgroup || 'primary' }}",
  "ClientRequestToken": "n8n-analytics-slack-report-exec-{{ $execution.id }}"
  {{ $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation ? ', "ResultConfiguration": { "OutputLocation": "' + $('Config').first().json.athenaOutputLocation + '" }' : '' }}
}
